# Merkava Flagship Revelation — Phase Two

The Awtsmoos does not improve a flagship by multiplying decoration;
Awtsmoos.com improves it by making every dependency, layer, gesture, and visible state tell the truth of its purpose.

## Twenty concrete improvements to the first plan

1. Scope every Merkava selector beneath `#gameShell` so shared player-shell controls cannot inherit battlefield styles.
2. Remove bare universal `*` styling; use `#gameShell, #gameShell *` only where box sizing is needed.
3. Eliminate `html` and `body` sizing dependencies by making `#gameShell` the fixed viewport-local root.
4. Define named layer tokens on `#gameShell` for canvas, labels, HUD, overlays, notification, fatal state, and optional commerce.
5. Replace every raw Merkava z-index with those tokens.
6. Add a dedicated `interactions.css` so button/link/form state styling is not duplicated across feature sheets.
7. Scope hover motion to `(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)`.
8. Keep `:active` feedback universal for mouse, pen, and touch.
9. Give every relevant action a visible `:focus-visible` ring independent from hover color.
10. Add a local reduced-motion module instead of global `*` animation overrides.
11. Preserve overlay internal scrolling while preventing the page itself from gaining accidental scrollbars.
12. Make all overlay/panel widths use bounded logical sizes and safe-area-aware padding.
13. Keep mobile controls at a 44px interaction floor.
14. Build an explicit input-action adapter instead of handing mutable game state to the input controller.
15. Give the input controller a `connect()` / `disconnect()` lifecycle with named bound handlers.
16. Inject the keyboard target rather than hard-coding `window` inside input logic.
17. Introduce a small base input-port class so gesture lifecycle and public contract can be extended without editing the concrete controller.
18. Move runtime-error ownership out of `main.js` into one journal class while preserving legacy diagnostic globals for browser tests.
19. Move optional-commerce boot into a focused service so optional commerce cannot clutter the battlefield bootstrap.
20. Rewrite `main.js` as a tiny composition root with extensive per-function JSDoc and one explicit bootstrap object.

## API constraints

- Preserve `window.__MERKAVA_APP__`, `window.__MERKAVA_DIAGNOSTICS__`, and `window.__MERKAVA_RUNTIME_ERRORS__` until the existing browser-driver contract is migrated separately.
- Preserve zero-argument `new MerkavaApp()` compatibility for diagnostic/tests, but allow an optional dependency vessel.
- Preserve GameState property names used throughout gameplay; improve names at new boundaries instead of renaming hundreds of stable internal references in one wave.
- No save-schema change.
- No combat/economy/route rule change.

## Candidate new source vessels

- `styles/tokens.css`
- `styles/interactions.css`
- `styles/motion.css`
- `src/input/YesodInputPort.js`
- `src/input/MerkavaInputActions.js`

- `styles/foundation.css`
